en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : , and are d2sp3 hybridised.

Statement II : and are paramagnetic and have 4 and 5 unpaired electrons, respectively.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: Statement I is correct but statement II is false
Both statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is incorrect but statement II is true
Both statement I and statement II are true

en.explanation:
Hybridization of all the given complexes are given in following table.

CN is a strong field ligand.

Pairing of electron takes place.

CN is a strong ligand.

Pairing of electron takes place.

F is a weak field ligand.

Pairing of electron does not occurs.

Cl is a weak field ligand.

Pairing of electron does not occurs.

So, both statement I and statement II are true.

hi.content:

कथन I : , और d2sp3 हाइब्रिडाइज्ड हैं।

कथन II : और पैरामैग्नेटिक हैं और क्रमशः 4 और 5 अजोड़ित इलेक्ट्रॉन हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें।

options.content: कथन I सही है लेकिन कथन II गलत है
कथन I और कथन II दोनों गलत हैं
कथन I गलत है लेकिन कथन II सही है
कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

en.content:
To an aqueous solution containing ions such as Al3+, Zn2+, Ca2+, Fe3+, Ni2+, Ba2+ and Cu2+ was added conc. HCl, followed by H2S.

The total number of cations precipitated during this reaction is/are :
en.explanation:
Al3+ and Fe3+ sulphides hydrolyse in water.

Ni2+ and Zn2+ require basic medium with H2S to form ppt

Ca2+ and Ba2+ sulphides are soluble

hence, we will receive only CuS ppt.

hi.content:
Al3+, Zn2+, Ca2+, Fe3+, Ni2+, Ba2+ और Cu2+ जैसे आयनों वाले जलीय घोल में conc. HCl डाला गया, उसके बाद H2S डाला गया।

इस प्रतिक्रिया के दौरान कुल कितने कैटियन अवक्षेपित होते हैं :

en.content: Compound A gives D-Galactose and D-Glucose on hydrolysis. The compound A is :

options.content: Amylose
Sucrose
Maltose
Lactose

en.explanation:
Lactose : It is a disaccharide of -D-Galactose and -D-Glucose with C1 of galactose and C4 of glucose link.

Lactose : -D-Galactose + -D-Glucose

options.content: एमाइलोज़
